subject: rt-dym
title: RT.DYM.------POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 58 (SD(SY)-36). RT-DYM (reality dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From the subject: CN-INFO (controlled information), INFO-DE-B (information degrees) and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From CN-INFO: JR-DYM (journalism dynamics). From INFO-DE-B: IST-PT (isolated particulars). From RT-INT-TR: C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From JR-DYM: CRT (criticism). From AFTD: ATT (attitude).
